definitions.explanation: A physical fight, competitive match, or direct contest between opponents.
A figurative struggle against adversity, illness, or difficult circumstances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{闘|たたか}いだった。
⟦チャンピオン→チャンピオン：19399_chanpion⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{闘|たたか}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The fight against the champion has begun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両者|りょうしゃ}→両者：11357_ryousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{闘|たたか}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦ラウンド→ラウンド：24227_raundo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The bout between the two continued for three rounds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{闘|たたか}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。

examples.english: His struggle gave courage to many people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{差別|さべつ}→差別：01633_sabetsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{闘|たたか}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: After a long struggle against discrimination, the law was changed.

notes:
USAGE:
The noun form of ⟦{闘|たたか}う→闘う：17304_tatakau⟧. Written with {闘|たたか} rather than {戦|たたか} to emphasize personal combat, competitive bouts, or struggles against adversity. ⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧ tends to refer to wars and large-scale battles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{闘|たたか}い (struggle against illness)
- {闘|たたか}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑|いど}む→挑む：12708_idomu⟧ (to take on a fight)
- {闘|たたか}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる→繰り広げる：06982_kurihirogeru⟧ (to wage a prolonged fight)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧: fight, battle — focuses on wars and large-scale conflicts
